## What's new

### Everything in the new Starlight design
The classic Moonlight screens are gone. Every option now lives natively in the Starlight interface.

**No more top bar**
- The old Moonlight navigation bar (Settings / PC name / Select New Host) is removed for good. It no longer comes back after you leave a stream.

**PC picker**
- Tapping the PC capsule lists **Your PCs**, plus any **other PCs found on your network** (tap one to pair), **Refresh Games** and **Add PC by Address…**
- Choosing an offline PC shows its cached games instead of a pop-up sheet. Wake PC is in Settings.

**Pinned games**
- **Pin** puts the game in the app icon's long-press menu, as before. Pinned games now also come **first** in Continue Playing, All Games and Library, and carry a small gold pin badge.
- Pin is now only in the **•••** menu (and on long-press). The separate pin button is gone.

**Running games**
- While a game is running on the PC, it's featured first and shows **Resume** and **Quit** side by side.

**One ••• menu**
- The ••• menu and the long-press menu now hold every option directly: **Pin/Unpin**, **Copy Shortcut Link**, **Save Icon to Photos**, **Hide/Show Game** and, while running, **Quit Game**.
- **Resume** and **More Options…** are removed from it.

**Native Settings**
- **Stream Settings** opens as a native screen: resolution (incl. Safe Area, Full Screen and custom), frame rate, bitrate, codec, HDR, frame pacing, touch mode, on-screen controls, multi-controller, swap A/B X/Y, Bluetooth mouse, optimize game settings, play audio on PC and statistics overlay. Changes save automatically.
- Each **PC** has its own screen: status and address, Pair, Use This PC, Refresh Games, Show Hidden Games, Wake PC, Test Network and Remove PC.
- **Game Artwork** (SteamGridDB) has its own screen: enter the key, download missing artwork, re-download everything or remove it.
- **About** shows the version and credits.
- Settings now always use the dark theme.

### Removed
- The classic Moonlight layout and the side settings panel.

## Install
Download `Starlight.ipa` below and install it with [Sideloadly](https://sideloadly.io) over your current version, using the same Bundle ID.
